description.text: A starter deck built around Metagross, a Pokémon of both the Psychic and Metal types, released on 16 January 2004 alongside Undone Seal, the fourth ADV expansion. Jirachi is among its Pokémon. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
